title.hr: Nepovratni trošak: odlučuje se gledajući naprijed

concept.hr: Potrošeno je potrošeno na svakom putu; računa se samo ono što tek dolazi
concept.en: What is spent is spent whichever way; only what is still to come counts

summary.hr: Projekt koji kasni, s odlukama nastaviti, prijeći ili odustati: prema već potrošenom ili prema onome što tek dolazi, uz vrijeme tima i otpis starog sustava.
summary.en: An overrunning project with gates to continue, switch or stop: deciding by money already spent or by what is still to come, with team time and a write-off.

title.en: The old system on the books

concept.hr: Knjigovodstvena vrijednost starog sustava nije razlog da ga se zadrži
concept.en: An old system's remaining book value is no reason to keep it
